description: Change one task on a trip checklist: its text, its category (section heading), or whether it is done. Get checklist_id and item_id from trip_checklists. Send only what changes. checked true marks the task done for the current user (on a shared trip it shows complete once every traveler ticks it); checked false unticks it. category "" removes the task from its section. Never show IDs to users.

checked.description: true marks the task done for the current user; false unticks it.

checklist_id.description: The checklist note's segment ID (checklist_id from trip_checklists).

name: checklist_item_update
title: Update Checklist Item
